comment: Tab hides the dockers with the pointer resting in the Colour Picker, a second Tab brings the docker back under it, the hand twitches by a few pixels and B is pressed. B has to reach the canvas and pick the Brush, and the Colour Picker has to take the keyboard only after the pointer has stayed in it. Last, a pointer that crosses a docker's edge the ordinary way still shows the swatch's tooltip. Nothing is saved.
00, the pointer crosses into the Colour Picker the ordinary way, which takes the keyboard on the first motion as before.
02, the docker is back under the resting pointer, and a twitch of four pixels leaves the keyboard with the canvas.
04, the pointer stays inside past the dwell of 0.6 s, and the docker takes the keyboard.
05, out to the canvas and across the edge onto the swatch, whose tooltip shows.
